column7: session half of credential-under-suspend-001 (#2701): a session committed after the suspend's DeleteSessionsForUserExcept swept the table is inert until reactivation and then live until its own expiry (RefreshSession can extend it to the absolute ceiling). RotateSession's freshly inserted row has the same exposure and gets the same re-check -- its CAS on rotated_at serializes it against another rotation, not against a credential sweep. Red on real Postgres: one live session survived a suspend that reported success
